structured_sections.name: Intro
lines: Title: Paani Peene Ka Bahaana (Classroom Ki Khidki)
Duration: ~3:15
Genre: Bollywood Acoustic Indie Ballad / School Nostalgia

structured_sections.name: Intro
lines: (Soft fingerpicked acoustic guitar, faint school corridor chatter, distant bell chime)

structured_sections.name: Mukhda / Chorus
lines: Paani peene ka toh bas ek bahaana tha,
Mujhe tere classroom ke aage se jaana tha.
Haath mein wooden pass, dheeme se kadam,
Tujhe mud ke dekhne ka khwaab puraana tha.
Class ki khidki se jab dhoop chhan ke aati,
Teri bench pe gir ke woh noor ban jaati.
Haan paani peene ka toh bas bahaana tha,
Mujhe tere classroom ke aage se jaana tha!

structured_sections.name: Antara 1 / Verse 1
lines: Subah ki assembly mein lambi si line thi,
Dono ke beech bas do chaar deewarein thin.
Prayer ke beech mein main gardan ghumata,
Tujhe dhoondhne mein hi ik sukoon paata.
Ek baar galti se aankhein jo mil gayin,
Puri din ki thakan chupke se dhal gayi.
Tu aage waali row mein baithi thi khamosh,
Aur aakhri bench pe udta mera hosh!
Recess ki ghanti pe dabba kholna,
Doston se chhipaa ke tera rukh dekhna.

structured_sections.name: Mukhda Reprise / Chorus
lines: Bina baat ke hi dil dhadakne lagta tha,
Yeh masoom sa lamha kitna suhaana tha.
Paani peene ka toh bas ek bahaana tha,
Mujhe tere classroom ke aage se jaana tha!

structured_sections.name: Antara 2 / Verse 2
lines: Ik din jo maangi thi tune woh pencil,
Aadhi chhil ke di maine kitni mushkil se.
Uss naye se shikhar pe jo tera lams tha,
Jaise mere hisse ka sabse bada jashn tha.
Blackboard pe teacher ke uljhe sawaal,
Par khayaalon mein bas tera hi khayaal.
Science ke period mein khwaabon ko bunte,
Dhadkan mein hum bas teri baat sunte.
Chhutti ki ghanti baji, bag utha liya,
Cycle ke stand pe tujhko phir pa liya.

structured_sections.name: Bridge
lines: Na kabhi himmat hui keh sakoon do lafz,
Na kabhi tu samajh paayi mera yeh marz.
Purani uniform ki jeb mein aaj bhi,
Tera gira eraser mehfooz hai kahin...
Haan mehfooz hai kahin!
Woh bachpana bhi kitna ajeeb tha,
Jitna door tha tu, utna kareeb tha.

structured_sections.name: Outro
lines: Do bench aage tu... aakhri bench pe main...
Corridor ke mod pe dhoondhta raha chain...
Paani peene ka toh bas ek bahaana tha...
Tujhe door se bas ek baar dekh aana tha...
(Soft acoustic guitar decay, distant ringing bell, gentle corridor fade out)
